resolved_findings.issue: Canonical JSON accepted duplicate fields and overflow floats; deep rejection depended on interpreter behavior.
resolved_findings.resolution: Canonical-only unique object pairs, finite float parsing, controlled decoder errors and explicit iterative depth32 limit; portable64-depth case rejected.

resolved_findings.issue: Switching deployed YAML to generic JSONFormatter exposed arbitrary plain extras.
resolved_findings.resolution: YAML include_context=false and canonical formatter always omits plain extras/exception message+traceback; type retained. Existing message contents remain caller responsibility, not claimed universally scrubbed.

resolved_findings.issue: str.splitlines split valid Unicode separators inside serialized JSON strings.
resolved_findings.resolution: Canonical stream splits physical LF only; actual YAML producer-to-collector regression covers U+0085/U+2028/U+2029.

assessment.deployed_config_path: Dockerfile CMD explicitly loads /app/logging_config.yaml; existing paper Compose mounts ./logs at /app/logs. Backend handler receives plain+structlog records; configure_api_logging changes root only. Real-YAML subprocess test exercises bootstrap plus actual collector/publish/replay. No installed runtime exercised.
assessment.record_contract: Real JSON escaping, UTC record.created timestamps, schema intra_session_log_v1; append by record UTC date and restart append. New collection selects exactly logs/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl and rejects rotated siblings, missing evidence, capture mutation, malformed/unversioned/wrong-day/non-UTC/truncated/invalidUTF8/duplicate/nonfinite/deep records and coverage gaps.
assessment.legacy: Old packs without log_contract retain legacy parser. Historical rotations/packs are not rewritten and Monday remains blocked; prospective file selection cannot claim a clean prior session.
assessment.decision_surface: No decision/order submission/model/ML/Kelly/entry/exit/feed changes. The120-second collector freshness and coverage thresholds unchanged. Freeze artifact byte-identical to base; cutoff preserved.
assessment.sensitive_handling: Additional plain extras/exception text omitted from deployed ordinary+canonical output; existing structured/event strings retain existing caller scrubbing expectations. Evidence remains private operational material.

validation.test_scope: Owner targeted logging/daily/host/standdown/adjacent logging and config/system integration; no duplicate full suite rerun by reviewer.
validation.skip: Existing TestInfraLogging.test_structured_logger reports StructuredLogger not available; not counted as pass.

limitations: No actual-host log installation or natural-session coverage attested. A complete new session remains necessary.
Append mode and stable capture do not make source log files tamper-proof; observations do not certify uninterrupted availability or all trading paths.
Daily logs are retained without pruning; separate capacity/retention policy remains needed.
Existing raw message contents must continue to avoid secrets; this change is not a comprehensive historical-log redaction.
Malformed canonical records withhold coverage even when unrelated to a trading decision.
Full safety/replay/artifact pack, exact hosted acceptance and deployment remain parent-owned gates.
